capturePolicy.purpose: Preserve distilled SakthiAI decisions, capability gaps, innovation candidates and next actions without publishing raw conversations or secrets.
capturePolicy.captureRule: Capture the decision, rationale, owner/public boundary, evidence source and implementation status; never copy a whole private conversation into Git history.

northStar.goal: Build SakthiAI into a benchmark-proven world-class AI operating platform rather than a feature-count clone.
northStar.strategy: Owner/private experimental capability first; harden and graduate only proven capabilities to public use.
moats: transparent cost, latency, provenance and authority

ownerPilot.label: Owner Pilot
ownerPilot.definition: Useful capability may run for the owner behind exact-owner identity, feature flags, default-deny permissions, explicit budget limits and rollback controls before public hardening.

publicCandidate.label: Public Candidate
publicCandidate.definition: Capability has passed security, privacy, licensing, tenancy, abuse, reliability, accessibility, cost and rollback gates and is eligible for controlled public rollout.

watch.label: Watch
watch.definition: Promising technology to research or benchmark before committing implementation resources.

reject.label: Reject / Defer
reject.definition: Low strategic value, excessive lock-in/risk, unsupported claims or poor cost-benefit; retain rationale rather than silently forgetting the idea.

decisions.title: Private-first, public-later capability graduation
decisions.decision: Advanced agent, computer, persistent-compute and experimental model features may be implemented for owner use first; public exposure requires a separate graduation gate.
decisions.rationale: This preserves development velocity without pretending an owner prototype is safe for untrusted multi-user production.

decisions.title: Dashboard is the canonical design-memory surface
decisions.decision: Important SakthiAI ideas and decisions from future discussions are distilled into this dashboard/registry rather than relying on conversational recall alone.
decisions.rationale: A structured decision ledger is searchable, reviewable, versioned and less likely to lose constraints than an unstructured transcript.

decisions.title: Functional parity without proprietary cloning
decisions.decision: Capture the valuable Manus, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Kimi and other market workflows while keeping SakthiAI contracts provider-neutral and avoiding copied proprietary code, prompts, weights, branding or protected UI.
decisions.rationale: The durable asset is SakthiAI's architecture and user experience, not dependency on one competitor.

decisions.title: World-best claim must be benchmarked
decisions.decision: Do not claim SakthiAI is best-in-world or Fable-equivalent based on roadmap breadth; prove advantages on representative research, coding, long-horizon agent, multimodal, cost and reliability benchmarks.
decisions.rationale: Feature quantity without quality, reliability and economics creates a fragile product rather than a moat.

innovationRadar.technology: Kimi Agent Swarm and K3 long-horizon agentic coding
innovationRadar.signal: Kimi documents large-scale automatic sub-agent coordination and very large parallel tool-call workloads.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Dynamic bounded agent fan-out, sub-agent resource pools, result deduplication and parallel batch/research execution.
innovationRadar.risk: Parallelism can multiply cost, duplicate work and amplify errors; SakthiAI must bound worker count and require verifier synthesis.

innovationRadar.technology: GLM-5.2/5.3 long-horizon coding, 1M context and ZCode computer automation
innovationRadar.signal: Z.ai is combining long context, coding effort controls, project memory, subagents, automation and computer/browser control.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Separate context capacity from task-state durability; add explicit effort levels, project memory inspection, reconnect recovery and visible computer permissions.
innovationRadar.risk: Vendor benchmark claims require independent validation and computer control requires strict permissions.

innovationRadar.signal: Qwen3.7 models combine image/text/video understanding, function calling, web search, screen perception and GUI/mobile navigation.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Open/replaceable multimodal perception lane for browser/mobile/computer tasks, with structured outputs and caching.
innovationRadar.risk: Model licensing, deployment footprint and GUI reliability must be checked per exact model release.

innovationRadar.signal: A2A has moved into production-oriented cross-vendor agent interoperability with broad ecosystem adoption.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Give SakthiAI agents discoverable capability cards, secure task handoff and cross-vendor collaboration instead of hard-coded proprietary agent calls.
innovationRadar.risk: Remote agents remain untrusted boundaries; identity, capability negotiation, provenance and authorization are mandatory.

innovationRadar.signal: A2UI lets remote agents describe safe native UI using declarative data rather than executing arbitrary frontend code.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Allow SakthiAI agents to return interactive forms, dashboards, charts and controls that render consistently on web/mobile using an approved component catalog.
innovationRadar.risk: Component catalog and action binding must remain host-controlled; never treat generated UI as automatic authorization.

innovationRadar.signal: Gemini integrates computer use with search, maps grounding and function calling for browser/mobile/desktop agents.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Use one multimodal perception/action contract across browser, desktop and mobile while preserving the SakthiAI connector-first hierarchy.
innovationRadar.risk: Visual computer operation should remain fallback behind reliable APIs/DOM automation.

innovationRadar.signal: Sakana reports improvements by dynamically orchestrating multiple frontier models rather than relying on one model.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Invest in orchestration quality, diversity-aware model selection and verifier ensembles; this can be a stronger moat than chasing a single largest model.
innovationRadar.risk: Vendor-reported benchmark gains must be reproduced before claims or routing policy changes.

innovationRadar.technology: Unified Work/Code/Chat agent plus MCP connectors and human-in-loop tool execution
innovationRadar.signal: Mistral is converging productivity, coding and chat around reusable connectors and explicit tool approvals.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: One shared conversation/agent runtime should power work, code and chat surfaces while connector permissions stay centrally governed.
innovationRadar.risk: Do not reproduce product branding/UI; use open MCP contracts and SakthiAI-native approval semantics.

innovationRadar.signal: H3 combines text, image, video and audio context with video generation and native stereo audio.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Creative Studio should evolve toward one multimodal project context instead of isolated image/video/audio tools.
innovationRadar.risk: High compute/storage cost plus content provenance, rights and safety requirements.

innovationRadar.signal: SeedRealtime combines continuous audio, video and text perception with proactive speech and tool calls.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Future Sakthi Live mode should support interruptible full-duplex voice, screen/camera understanding and event-driven proactive assistance under explicit user controls.
innovationRadar.risk: Continuous sensing is privacy-sensitive; opt-in capture indicators, local processing where feasible and no silent recording are mandatory.

innovationRadar.signal: The product direction is moving from short prompt-to-clip generation toward controllable creative work with references and iterative extensions.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Build a creative timeline/project layer with shot continuity, reference assets, extension and revision rather than a one-shot video button.
innovationRadar.risk: Rights/provenance and compute economics must be solved before broad public generation.

innovationRadar.technology: Always-on computer agents and integrated speech-to-speech voice agents
innovationRadar.signal: Grok Bot and Voice Agent Builder illustrate persistent AI coworkers plus lower-latency unified voice-agent stacks.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Persistent agent workers need approval escalation, memory, dedicated compute and observability; live voice should minimize unnecessary STT/LLM/TTS hops.
innovationRadar.risk: Always-on agents expand attack surface and ongoing cost; owner pilot only until isolation/kill-switch/evidence are mature.

innovationRadar.signal: ERNIE 5.0 describes a unified autoregressive architecture across text, image, video and audio instead of late-fusing separate modality systems.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Keep SakthiAI's multimodal API and memory representation modality-neutral so future unified models can replace stitched pipelines cleanly.
innovationRadar.risk: Do not tie product architecture to one vendor/model implementation.

innovationRadar.technology: Codex long-running professional work, plugins, shareable sites and computer use
innovationRadar.signal: Codex is expanding from coding into broader professional workflows and remote computer operation with steering across devices.
innovationRadar.whatSakthiAILearns: Sakthi Code should be an execution substrate usable by technical and non-technical workflows, with remote steering and interactive result surfaces.
innovationRadar.risk: External OpenAI use remains optional; SakthiAI's task state and artifacts must stay portable.

graduationGates: threat model and abuse cases complete
data classification, privacy and retention contract complete
multi-tenant isolation and server-side authorization proven
cost and quota limits tested under abuse and retry storms
failure recovery, task checkpoints and restore evidence complete
accessibility plus Tamil/English acceptance criteria passed
observability, incident response and emergency stop proven
benchmark and regression evidence meets the advertised claim
